---
description: Research Azure AI Agent Service capabilities and suggest the next exercises to create based on gaps in current coverage.
---

## Step 1: Catalog Current Exercises

Read all files in `Instructions/` and list the capabilities each exercise teaches.

## Step 2: Research New Capabilities

Search for the latest Azure AI Agent Service and Microsoft Foundry SDK documentation to identify features not yet covered by any exercise. Focus on:

- New SDK classes and methods
- New tool types (beyond Code Interpreter, custom functions, MCP)
- New agent patterns (streaming, evaluation, multi-modal)
- New integration points (Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Bing)

## Step 3: Propose Next Exercises

For each gap, propose an exercise with:
- Title and number
- Learning objectives
- Which SDK features it introduces
- Prerequisites (which existing exercises should be completed first)
- Estimated difficulty level
- Brief outline of the implementation steps

Rank proposals by practical value and teaching progression.
